law_name: Law No. 133/V/2001 of 22 January 2001 (General Legal Regime for Personal Data Protection of Natural Persons), as amended by Law No. 41/VIII/2013 and Law No. 121/IX/2021
scope: Natural persons whose data is processed by controllers established in Cabo Verde or using equipment there
applies_to: Public and private controllers (automated and manual files, incl. video surveillance)
key_requirements: Data-subject rights of information, access, objection, rectification and erasure; CNPD supervision; special security measures for sensitive data
data_categories: Personal data; special/sensitive data, including health and genetic data (access to which is exercised through a doctor)
enforcement_authority: Comissao Nacional de Protecao de Dados Pessoais (CNPD)
penalties_range: Administrative fines: CVE 50,000-500,000 (individuals) and CVE 300,000-3,000,000 (legal entities), doubled for processing subject to prior CNPD control; other administrative offences CVE 100,000-1,000,000; daily sanction CVE 5,000 (individual) / 10,000 (entity); criminal penalties vary by offence (up to 1-2 years' imprisonment or 120-240 days' fine; breach of professional secrecy 6 months-3 years)
genetic_data: Health and genetic data: access by the data subject is exercised through a doctor (special-data regime)
notes: Law 121/IX/2021 (published 2021-03-17) amends the regime to align with Convention 108+ and amends CNPD statute Law 42/VIII/2013; its effective date was not found. CNPD operational since 2015. cnpd.cv not confirmed.; effective_date not found: the enactment date is used
